title: Fate Writing
next_chapter_hook: "Your lifespan diminished by another three years, yet Chen Ji stared at the slowly stabilizing time-space rift and revealed a faint smile—the residual soul of Mo Xiansheng deep within the Tianji Record let out a low sigh: 'Are you certain you can afford this price?'"

text.content: "The time-space rift resembled an eyelid closing,吞噬着 the Tianqing Sect messenger's figure bit by bit. Chen Ji stood in place, spine straight, his expression calm to the point of cold indifference. Only those deep, abyss-like eyes, in the final moment the messenger vanished, flickered with a cold light no one could捕捉. 'Within three days, give me your answer—or the Heaven's Eye's inescapable lethal situation will arrive early.' That voice still echoed in his ears, like a sword hanging above his head."

"Chen Ji slowly lowered his gaze, the corner of his lips curving into the faintest arc. Heaven's Eye? Inescapable lethal situation? He rolled those words across his tongue, tasting a trace of irony. In his previous life he died under the calculations of the Heavenly Dao Chess Game; this second life, he had long seen through the so-called heavenly mandate. It was merely a chessboard arranged by beings from higher realms, and he, Chen Ji, would never again be a piece to be manipulated."

"He sat cross-legged on the ground, taking the scroll of the fragmented Tianji Record from his怀中. The yellowed pages fluttered slightly in the night wind as Chen Ji's fingertips gently brushed across those obscure symbols, sensing the ancient power contained within. This fragment had accompanied him for years, witnessing his journey from a废物 servant to where he stands today. Yet tonight, it seemed to respond to that conversation, emanating an unprecedented fluctuation."

dialogue.content: "'You've finally discovered it.' An aged and ethereal voice emerged from deep within the Tianji Record, like wind passing through withered leaves, carrying the weight of years. Chen Ji's gaze shifted slightly, yet showed no surprise. He had heard this voice countless times; every critical moment, it guided him out of dilemmas. Mo Xiansheng—his nominal master, a guardian in soul remnant form, one of the greatest mysteries within the Tianji Record."

text.content: "'The 'Fate Writer' the messenger mentioned is an ability that only manifests when the Tianji Record is truly complete.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried no emotional fluctuation, as if stating an unrelated fact, 'It allows the user to rewrite the trajectory of fate, transforming the 'determined' into the 'undetermined.' However, the price of this power is far heavier than you imagine.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before speaking, his voice calm as water: 'Explain clearly.' Two brief words, without a trace of unnecessary emotion. He had never feared prices; surviving in the隙缝 between the business world and cultivation realm in his previous life had long taught him to trade everything usable for what he desired. Lifespan, flesh and blood, even souls—in his dictionary, there were never words like 'not worth it,' only 'is it worth it.'"

"'Each writing consumes three years of your lifespan.' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew several degrees heavier, 'Moreover, rewriting fate leaves traces; the Heaven's Eye will follow these traces to find you. Each use increases your exposure risk—and your current position in the Heavenly Dao Chess Game is already dangerous enough.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Three years of lifespan. This price was lighter than he anticipated, yet also heavier than expected."

choice.prompt: "The price of fate has been revealed—three years of lifespan in exchange for one chance to rewrite one's trajectory. Do you make this deal or not?"

choices.description: "Since the ability exists, it should be fully utilized. Three years of lifespan for one chance to break the局—this calculation was clear in his mind."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain first-time use opportunity of 'Fate Writer,' allowing rewrite of one impending fate node
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye will track you through traces, greatly increasing exposure risk

text.content: "Chen Ji's voice held not a shred of hesitation, as decisive as deciding what to eat tonight. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for an instant; from the depths of that soul remnant seemed to emerge an almost inaudible sigh. But the next moment, the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with blinding golden light; those dormant symbols surged like living things, weaving a illusory scroll before Chen Ji's eyes."

"'Very well.' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged once more, this time carrying a hint of something unfathomable, 'Since you've decided, let me show you the true usage of the 'Fate Writer'—use your blood as ink, lifespan as the brush, and write your desired outcome upon the blank spaces of heaven's design.'"

choices.description: "The ability is good, but using it at the knife's edge is the right principle. The three-day deadline still has room for maneuvering; no need to rush."
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the ability, waiting for a more suitable moment
choices.risk_hint: The three-day deadline passes in an instant; opportunities are fleeting

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly closed the Tianji Record, a shrewd calculation flickering in his eyes. He had never been an impulsive man; lessons from his previous life taught him to repeatedly weigh every move before acting. Three years of lifespan—this was a price he could bear—but it didn't mean he would dance to the rhythm his enemies set."

dialogue.content: "'You truly have composure.' A hint of admiration actually appeared in Mo Xiansheng's voice, 'But this old man must remind you—the messenger dared set a three-day deadline, which means great changes will certainly occur within these three days. If you wish to remain still and counter their moves, you may be disappointed.' Chen Ji's expression deepened at these words."

text.content: "Just then, the already nearly-closed time-space rift suddenly trembled. An eye emerged from that blurry虚空, its pupil reflecting countless stars and the interweaving of fates—the legendary Heaven's Eye. It did not speak, merely watching Chen Ji silently; that gaze pierced through the boundaries of time and space, as if wanting to see through his very soul."

dialogue.content: "'Interesting.' A voice came from within that eye, ancient and majestic, carrying no emotional color yet causing all the hair on Chen Ji's body to stand on end, 'The fragmented Tianji Record, fallen into a mortal's hands, yet still managed to nurture such a heterodox ability as 'Fate Writer.' You are more interesting than any prophet in history.' Chen Ji's heart sank violently. This voice, this pressure—it matched the messenger from before—the messenger was merely an avatar of the Heaven's Eye!"

text.content: "Yet Chen Ji's face remained unruffled. He slowly stood up, facing the Heaven's Eye's gaze, even allowing the corner of his lips to curve into a faint arc. 'Elder specially manifested your true form, just to take a look at Chen? Was the Tianji Record originally a piece set by the Elder, and now that the piece has developed its own thoughts, the Elder came to teach a lesson?'"

dialogue.content: "The Heaven's Eye's pupil slightly contracted, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's reaction. After a moment, it actually let out a low laugh. 'Bold.' That voice carried a playful tone, 'The Tianji Record was indeed once this seat's possession; a thousand years ago it fell into the mortal realm, intended to find a suitable inheritor. Who would have thought after a thousand years, it would fall into the hands of such an interesting person.' Chen Ji's eyes flashed. Fallen a thousand years ago? The messenger just said this ability was granted by the Tianji Record itself, and now it changes its story to claim the Tianji Record was originally a creation of the Heaven's Eye—how many secrets lie hidden in this?"

choice.prompt: "The Heaven's Eye personally admitted the Tianji Record was once its possession, implying the Tianqing Sect is merely a recycler. Faced with this existence transcending all else, how do you choose to respond?"

choices.description: "Since words have come this far, might as well speak plainly. The origins of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan's death, even his own rebirth—there must be secrets within these he does not know."
choices.visible_reward: May learn the true relationship between the Tianji Record and the Heaven's Eye
choices.risk_hint: The Heaven's Eye is capricious; questioning may bring disaster

dialogue.content: "'Since it is Elder's possession, Elder naturally knows all its secrets.' Chen Ji's voice was calm and clear, every word impactful, 'May I ask Elder—what is the true purpose of this 'Fate Writer' ability? Is it meant to let people rewrite fate, or to lead people into another trap?' A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, 'Chen is very curious—whether I am a piece set by Elder, or an 'accident' permitted to move freely.'"

text.content: "The Heaven's Eye fell silent for an instant; the stars within its pupil seemed to dim several degrees. 'You are more courageous than Chen Xuan.' Its voice carried a hint of something unfathomable, 'When he obtained the Tianji Record in those days, his first action was to kneel and kowtow, thanking this seat's grace. But you—' that gaze suddenly turned razor-sharp, 'You dare question this seat.' Chen Ji's heart tensed. Chen Xuan—that was the previous inheritor of the Tianji Record, also his nominal ancestor."

choices.description: "Directly confronting such an existence would be most unwise; better to show weakness to the enemy, gather more intelligence, then make calculations."
choices.visible_reward: May gain more information about the Heaven's Eye while concealing one's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Appearing too weak may cause being despised, missing the chance to learn the truth

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji slightly lowered his head, posture extremely humble, yet not lacking dignity. 'The junior was presumptuous; Elder forgive the失礼.' His voice held not a trace of anger, but carried a precisely-calibrated humility, 'The Tianji Record originated from Elder's hand; the junior merely a fortunate user. If Elder wishes to reclaim it, the junior shall offer it with both hands.' These words were beautifully spoken—declaring no intention to oppose the Heaven's Eye, while implying he was merely a temporary holder of the Tianji Record, returning the ball to the other party."

text.content: "A flicker of something inexplicable passed through the Heaven's Eye's pupil, as if reassessing this mortal before it. 'You whelp, you are somewhat interesting.' Its voice gained a playful tone, 'The Tianji Record in your hands does indeed possess more vitality than in others' hands. Since that is the case, this seat grants you an opportunity—within three days, if you can use the 'Fate Writer' to rewrite one fate node, this seat shall acknowledge your qualification to continue holding it.'"

"Before the words even finished, the Heaven's Eye slowly receded into the虚空, leaving only its final words echoing in Chen Ji's ears: 'Do not disappoint this seat.' The time-space rift completely closed; night once again enveloped the earth. Chen Ji stood in place, his eyes gleaming with sharp light. The three-day deadline, the Heaven's Eye's trial, and the 'inescapable lethal situation' the messenger mentioned—all were pushing him into a desperate corner. Yet his lips curved into a cold smile. Pushed into a corner? Then let's see who runs out of roads first."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji opened the Tianji Record, his gaze falling upon those yellowed pages. Mo Xiansheng's voice timely sounded: 'Since the Heaven's Eye has given you this chance, you cannot waste it.' After a pause, that aged voice gained a凝重 tone, 'The messenger said if no answer is given within three days, the lethal trap will arrive early. If you wish to破局, you must within three days use the 'Fate Writer' to rewrite one fate node related to that 'lethal trap.'' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then spoke: 'I understand.' He bit his fingertip, a drop of blood falling onto the Tianji Record. In an instant, golden light blazed!"

text.content: "That instant, Chen Ji felt as if he stood within the current of fate itself. Countless rays of light intertwined before his eyes; each ray represented a possible future. He saw Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's first genius; he saw Ye Qing, the Holy Sect's sacred maiden; he saw the undercurrents of power struggles within the Tianqing Sect—yet these images were all too blurred, too distant. He needed to find a critical enough node, one that could leverage the entire chess game. Suddenly, one image became clear before his eyes—that was three days later, before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate."

"Chen Ji saw himself. He saw himself standing before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, facing boundless black mist and countless demonic path cultivators. And within that black mist, a enormous eye coldly watched him—not the Heaven's Eye, but something far more terrifying. Inescapable lethal situation. He instantly understood. Three days later, the 'inescapable lethal situation' the Heaven's Eye mentioned would descend upon the Tianqing Sect in the form of demonic path invasion, and he, Chen Ji, was precisely the core of this great catastrophe. The trajectory of fate was clearly presented before him, and he simply needed to—rewrite it."

dialogue.content: "'Found it?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sense of urgency. Chen Ji gave no answer, merely pressing his finger upon that image. His lifespan was burning; three years of time flowed like sand between his fingers, yet there was not a moment's hesitation in his eyes. Rewriting fate—this was what he had been doing since his rebirth. Since heaven demanded his death, then he would rewrite this fate—turning the inevitable death into the possibility of certain survival. 'Fate Writing, activate.' He quietly spoke these words, his voice as calm as if merely stating an established fact. In an instant, golden light erupted; the Tianji Record went wild, pages flipping frantically; countless symbols rushed forth like a flood, completely tearing apart that image of inevitable death!"

text.content: "Golden light dispersed; fate rewriting complete. Chen Ji violently coughed up a mouthful of blood, his complexion instantly pale as paper. He could clearly feel something had forever disappeared from his life—that was three years of lifespan, that was the long future he should have had. Yet the corner of his lips curved into a smile, because he saw the changed fate. Three days later, the demonic path invasion would still come, but the location would no longer be the Tianqing Sect, but a wilderness on the eastern border. There, he would encounter an unexpected ally, and obtain a fortuitous encounter capable of reversing heaven and earth. This—was the future he desired."

"Chen Ji slowly closed the Tianji Record, tucking it close to his body. Night wind brushed his face, carrying away that trace of bloodstench, yet unable to carry away the cold light deep within his eyes. Three years of lifespan, in exchange for one chance to break the局. This calculation, he accepted. But he also clearly knew—after this engagement, the bond between himself and the Heaven's Eye had grown another degree deeper. That existence transcending all had already marked him as a piece worthy of attention. And he, Chen Ji, would never be content to be any person's piece—even heaven itself. Night deepened; the star river glowed brilliantly. The chess game of fate had only just begun."
